description: List orders in the workspace, newest first. Read-only. Filter by payment, fulfillment or delivery status, state (open/closed/canceled), customer, company (B2B), pipeline stage, warehouse queue (to pack, in transit, shipping problem, returns), a search string (customer email or company name), currency, or a creation date range. Filters combine. Each order carries its id, number, customer email, company, PO number, payment, fulfillment and delivery status, state, total and creation date. Items, parcels and returns of one order: get_order with its id. Paginated: while hasMore is true, pass nextCursor back as cursor while it is set; if hasMore is true but nextCursor is null, page with the offset instead, and past offset 10000 narrow the filter.

companyId.description: Only orders placed for this company record (B2B). Pass the company record's id - find it with list_records on the company model named by the account model's auth.companyField; a company name goes into search instead.

currency.description: Only orders placed in this currency (ISO 4217, e.g. EUR) - order totals are never added across currencies, so filter by it before summing

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page. The page continues after it in the same filter and sort; leave the skip/offset at 0 when you pass it

customerId.description: Only orders placed by this customer id

dateFrom.description: ISO date-time; only orders created at or after it

dateTo.description: ISO date-time; only orders created at or before it

deliveryStatus.description: Only orders with this delivery status

fulfillmentStatus.description: Only orders with this fulfillment status

limit.description: Page size, at most 100; pass nextCursor back as cursor while it is set

paymentStatus.description: Only orders with this payment status

pipelineStageId.description: Only orders in this pipeline stage (get_order_pipeline)

queue.description: A warehouse work queue, the same tabs as the admin order list: to_pack = open, paid and not yet fully shipped; in_transit = a parcel has a label or is on its way, without a delivery problem; shipping_problem = delivery status exception; returns = an open return. Combines with every other filter.

search.description: Case-insensitive contains match on the customer email or the frozen company name

skip.description: How many orders to skip, at most 10000 - the paging offset (there is no offset parameter); page past that with cursor

name: list_orders
title: List orders
